title: Pandemic Legacy: Season 1
subtitle: A cooperative campaign of disease control and survival
tagline: Every month brings new challenges and permanent changes
loreSummary: You are a team of disease control experts working together to keep four deadly diseases at bay for a full year. Every decision you make and every city that falls will permanently shape your world.
keyFeatures: Permanent world changes with stickers and destroyed cards
Evolving rules and objectives each month

pandemic1_standard.name: Standard Campaign
pandemic1_standard.description: A full year of play, assuming some months are lost and replayed.
